goal: Increase geometry/construction and dielectric glazing plausibility at oblique/grazing 4K views by replacing zero-thickness visual construction with a physically dimensioned 4 mm perimeter edge cue, while preserving the existing real-time transparent front surface and avoiding a duplicate broad transparent rear layer.

sourceFinding.problem: The generated fallback contract already described nominal 4 mm clear float glass, but the runtime construction used GM_FacadeOpticalPlane: one zero-thickness broad quad per visible pane. At oblique/grazing angles this left the construction thickness unrepresented even though the material contract implied it.
sourceFinding.existingAssembly: 30 apartment openings use two 1030 x 1460 mm sliding optical panes with 14 mm depth separation; five stair openings use 1120 x 1180 mm optical panes. Total visible panes: 65.
sourceFinding.chosenFix: Retain the existing broad front optical plane as the real-time transmission/Fresnel surface and add only four perimeter quads extending 4 mm inward. This creates real geometric edge orientation without a second broad transparent sheet that would compound fallback alpha/reflection sorting.
sourceFinding.realTimeCost: 8 triangles per pane, 520 added triangles total for 65 panes; the edge shell is intentionally retained across viewing distance rather than removed and creating a grazing construction pop.

implementation: Added QualityBlockFacadeGlassThicknessUpgrade with a canonical edge-only 16-vertex/8-triangle mesh spanning exactly 4 mm inward from each existing facade optical plane.

Each edge shell is a child of its source pane with zero local translation, identity rotation, unit scale, no collider, no shadow casting, and the exact same MAT_WindowClearGlass material as the broad front optical surface.

Bound generation to EditorSceneManager.sceneSaving for the benchmark scene. The existing preparation order rebuilds facade optics, then QualityBlockEnvironmentLightingUpgrade saves the scene; this save boundary creates/serializes the edges before later realtime reflection synchronization.

Added a machine-readable construction/material contract covering components, dimensions/thickness, mounting, interfaces, orientation, dry midsummer exposure, aging boundaries, geometry-vs-material ownership, LOD policy, required native-4K evidence and canonical critical-defect IDs.

Added full material metadata for tint/albedo proxy, IOR reference, dielectric F0 reference, metallic, roughness/smoothness, alpha proxy, normal scale, microstructure, wetness, UV aging and angular Fresnel behavior.
Added QualityBlockFacadeGlassThicknessContractQA to bind the metadata numerically back to the canonical MAT_WindowClearGlass asset instead of merely checking that descriptive JSON exists.
Added QualityBlockFacadeGlassThicknessFormalQA to fail closed before benchmark MainCamera culling if construction, topology, material binding or metadata validation fails.
Added a non-render SVG lookdev illustration documenting the 4 mm section, real construction ownership, dry midsummer light response and forbidden painted-border/metallic/duplicate-layer shortcuts.

selfAudit.finding: Initial machine contract omitted an explicit albedo/tint numeric field even though the mandatory material reasoning requires albedo as well as roughness/metallic/normal/microstructure/wetness/aging/Fresnel.
selfAudit.correction: Added albedoTintProxyRgba=[0.72,0.81,0.84,0.18] and a strict contract QA that checks those values plus the rest of the material metadata.

selfAudit.finding: Descriptive material metadata alone could drift away from the actual MAT_WindowClearGlass asset.
selfAudit.correction: Bound contract QA to the real material asset: shader identity, RGBA tint, metallic, smoothness-range membership, premultiplied transparency/ZWrite and non-emissive state must agree before formal rendering.

selfAudit.finding: A closed transparent box would be more geometrically literal but would introduce a second broad rear transparent layer in the current Standard-alpha fallback, increasing reflection/transparency sorting error and risking a visually stronger but less physically credible result.
selfAudit.correction: Kept one broad optical face and modeled only the four physical perimeter orientation changes. Contract explicitly forbids the duplicate broad rear surface for this fallback.

verification.notes: No Unity Runner or authoritative screenshot appeared during this run. Source APIs and existing preparation order were audited, but sceneSaving callback behavior, generated mesh serialization, transparent-edge sorting and actual 4K appearance remain runtime/render verification pending.

implementationReadiness.reason: This run materially strengthens source-side glazing construction and QA but does not satisfy the existing missing Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification block worth the remaining 7 points.

expectedScoreImpactOnly: Geometry & construction fidelity (20): positive candidate impact from real 4 mm pane-edge geometry and explicit sash/interface construction rather than a zero-thickness plane; no points until visible pixels confirm scale/seating.

Material/PBR physical plausibility (20): positive candidate impact from edge geometry sharing the same canonical nonmetallic dielectric material plus hard metadata-to-asset binding; no points until actual reflection/transmission response is observed.

Lighting/shadows/reflections (15): positive candidate impact because grazing response can now come from physical edge orientation rather than a painted border; actual probe/reflection balance remains unobserved.
Cinematic image quality (5): possible improvement to oblique/grazing construction read; unscored.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability (5): neutral/risk pending. Thin 4 mm edges may shimmer at distance, so temporal evidence is mandatory before treating this as positive.

mandatoryPixelReviewWhenRunnerAppears: oblique/construction_depth 3840x2160 + 100% crop: pane seating, actual perceived thickness, no floating/interpenetrating edge.
grazing/sash_rail_response 3840x2160 + 100% crop: physical edge/Fresnel cue, no painted border, no duplicate-transparent-layer look.
grazing/material_grazing 3840x2160 + 100% crop: nonmetallic glass, reflection/transparency sorting, highlight continuity.
hero/facade_center 3840x2160 + 100% crop: no immediately obvious repeated bright window outline.
Temporal sequence at 100%: thin-edge shimmer/aliasing and any distance-dependent construction pop.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/Editor compile and actual prepared-scene execution. At first Runner availability stop speculative expansion, verify sceneSaving generates the canonical edge mesh and 65 edge children before reflection synchronization, confirm full contract/formal pre-cull QA passes, then capture and review the required native 4K crops plus temporal pixels before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
